description: Every producer that builds a sheet or view `source` (or a `sources[]` fan-out entry) sets `industry` as a non-empty string — never an object, never dropped, and never placed outside `source` where the server's record whitelist silently drops it. A sheet saved before this change is backfilled at load time: `source.dataset` with no `source.industry` gets `industry = dataset` and gains an empty `sources: []`. v2 (UI1, 2026-09-17): a view MAY carry a top-level `board` object {tiles, slots}. `tiles` is the integer 1, 2 or 4; `slots` is an array of exactly `tiles` entries, each a non-negative integer index into `sheets` or null for an empty tile, with no sheet index repeated. `board` is written only when the user chose a board of 2 or 4 tiles, so every v1 view stays byte-identical and a view without `board` opens as one sheet, exactly as before. `active` still names the selected sheet; in board mode the selected tile is the slot holding `active`, else the first filled slot. Console.save_view adds `board` to its record whitelist and rejects a malformed board with 400 "The saved view's board does not match its sheets."; chart-studio-core.js:normalizeBoard applies the same rules on the client and, on open, drops a malformed board with a status note instead of failing the open. A `board` key anywhere else (inside `source`, inside a sheet) is not a board and is ignored by every consumer. v3 (Lane M, boards #50-#52, 2026-09-25): a sheet MAY carry `marksCards`, a list of 1 to 12 cards {id, name, measure?, type, encodings: {color, size, label, detail: [], tooltip: [], shape, path, angle}, opacity, border, halo, visible, selectable, zoomExtent, source?, geography?}. A pill is {column: integer >= 0, aggregation: one of sum|mean|count|median|min|max|countd}; detail and tooltip are lists of at most 24 pills; shape is null, a pill (optionally with glyphs: {member: shape}) or {glyph: shape}, a shape being one of the 22 in chart-studio-core.js GLYPHS; opacity is a whole percent 0-100; border and halo are automatic, none, ink, white or c1..c12 (theme.js categorical slots); visible, selectable and zoomExtent are booleans; every one of these keys is required and no other is allowed; ids are unique. Two or more cards are a dual axis: every card names its `measure`, no two the same, each one a pill on the sheet's Rows, and the sheet MAY carry `syncAxes: true`. The v2 `marks` object stays readable forever and is always written: with one card it is canonical for type, color, size, label, detail and tooltip and `marksCards` holds only what v2 cannot; with a dual axis it mirrors the first card, so a console without v3 opens the view as that card. A sheet with one card and no v3-only field is written in the v2 shape, byte-identical (marks_v2_sheet -> marks_v2_written). Console.save_view refuses a malformed card set with 400 "The saved view's marks cards are malformed."; source and geography are hooks for map layers (lane P).

negative_controls.why: source.industry must be a non-empty string (S4_DESIGN.md section 4); an object is the exact DE-021 shape (a field agreed in prose as 'a string' that a producer sends as something else)
every sources[] entry must carry industry alongside dataset/label; an entry missing it cannot be resolved against the registry and openability() would silently treat it as unaddressed
source.industry must be a non-empty string; an empty string is indistinguishable from 'never set' and must be rejected the same as a missing key, not accepted as a valid (if blank) industry
sheet.sources must be an array of {industry, dataset, label} entries, never a bare string; a string here is the same DE-021 shape as source.industry-as-object, just on the fan-out list

the record whitelist in Console.save_view (server.py ~:963) builds `value` from named keys only (id, name, saved_at, sourceKey, source, sheets, active); a top-level industry key outside `source` is silently DROPPED, so a producer that puts it there instead of inside `source` is wrong even though the request itself is not otherwise malformed
board.tiles must be 1, 2 or 4 (one tile, two side by side, two by two); 3 has no layout, so Console.save_view returns 400 and normalizeBoard returns null
board.slots must have exactly board.tiles entries; a shorter or longer list leaves a tile undefined or a sheet unplaced
every filled slot must index an existing sheet (0 <= index < sheets.length); this view has two sheets and names sheet 5
a sheet may sit in one slot only; the same chart twice is a duplicate, not a board
slot entries are non-negative integers or null; a negative or fractional index is the DE-021 shape (agreed as an index, sent as something else)
board must be an object {tiles, slots}; a bare string or number is the same DE-021 shape as source.industry-as-object
a card's type must be a mark the Marks card offers; 'sparkle' is not one
encodings.detail is a list of pills; a single pill object there is the DE-021 shape (agreed as a list, sent as something else)
a pill's column is an integer index; the string '3' is the DE-021 shape
opacity is a whole percent from 0 to 100; 140 is not
border is automatic, none, ink, white or a theme slot c1-c12; a raw colour name is refused
every card of a dual axis names its measure; a card without one has no axis to sit on
a card's measure must be on the sheet's Rows; this one names a measure the shelves do not hold
card ids are unique within a sheet; two cards called card-1 cannot be told apart
marksCards is a list; an object keyed by card id is the DE-021 shape
a card carries only the contract's keys; 'colour' is a misspelling the record would otherwise keep
